newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal earns 20.5 bln esc from BTA sale.
newsitem.headline: Portugal earns 20.5 bln esc from BTA sale.

text.p: Portugal's government earned 20.5 billion escudos ($135 million) from the privatisation of a 13.22 percent stake in Portuguese bank Banco Totta e Acores, Lisbon bourse said.
"I am pleased with the results," Totta president Alipio Dias told reporters at Lisbon bourse where the results of the sale were announced. "I think the price (2,630 escudos) reassures investors."
He said 800,000 shares were placed in the direct national sale and 5,289,471 shares in the international direct sale.
Under-Secretary for Finance Fernando Teixeira dos Santos said the fixed price of 2,630 escudos per share was in-line with the market and the bookbuilding process.
"I think the price corresponds to the market situation and the evaluations made during the bookbuilding process," Teixeira dos Santos told reporters.
-- Paula Cordeiro, Lisbon newsroom +351-1-3538254 ($ = 151.9 Portugese Escudos)
